Amazon opens 1 million-square-foot Visalia distribution center, creating 600-plus jobs

# Amazon opens 1 million-square-foot Visalia distribution center, creating 600-plus jobs

by Stephen Hawkins

Fri, August 21, 2026 at 9:35 AM

Updated Fri, August 21, 2026 at 1:19 PM

4 VIEW ALL PHOTOS

Amazon opens 1 million-square-foot Visalia distribution center, creating 600-plus jobs (Photo: FOX26 Photojournalist Bert Montelongo)

VISALIA, Calif. (FOX26) — Amazon has opened a new distribution center in Visalia that the company says will speed up deliveries across Central California while creating more than 600 full-time jobs.

The more than 1 million-square-foot facility launched operations on Sunday and is Amazon’s third logistics site in the region. 

Amazon said the site is designed to optimize storage and inventory flow, allowing the company to deliver a wider selection of products to customers faster.

The new facility is located at 4001 North Plaza Drive in Visalia.

The Visalia distribution center will function as a regional hub, receiving products directly from vendors and other Amazon facilities and replenishing smaller fulfillment centers that handle final delivery to customers.

# NFI expands eCommerce network with new California fulfillment center 

 

> NFI expands eCommerce network with new California fulfillment center 

NFI has expanded its eCommerce network with a new fulfillment operation in Eastvale, California.

The new facility strengthens NFI’s bi-coastal fulfillment strategy and supports the growth of an apparel customer on the US West Coast.

NFI said the Eastvale location will improve replenishment cycles, delivery speeds and time-to-consumer across key markets.

The facility also complements the company’s broader West Coast distribution network and supports multichannel fulfillment and parcel shipping operations across North America.

“In 2022, we launched NFI eCom to help brands scale through an end-to-end fulfillment solution built for growth,” said William Mahoney, Chief Commercial Officer at NFI.

“As customer demand continues to evolve, we are expanding our vast network to provide greater speed, flexibility, and operational excellence.”
